answers.falsifier: on nt, local_executor hands _run an argv whose first element is shutil.which('bash'), where it was the bare word bash ; an AST scan of relay.py finds no list literal starting with the bare string bash outside _bash
answers.how: In cairn/devices/sudo_relay/relay.py add a private _bash() returning shutil.which('bash') or 'bash' where os.name is nt, else 'bash'; local_executor uses it. root_executor is unchanged (sudo does not exist on Windows). The red-first proof stubs _run to capture argv and asserts argv[0], plus an AST scan of relay.py that no list literal begins with the bare string bash outside _bash.
